serhii.name: Serhii
serhii.text: Mark is a great English teacher and a kind, friendly person. What I like most is how personalized lessons are. As an IT developer, I wanted to focus on work topics. He doesn’t just teach grammar, he discusses programming concepts and company workflows.

alexandra.name: Alexandra
alexandra.text: After many attempts on Preply, I finally found the right teacher. Mark is an exceptional teacher with deep technical knowledge. He inspires, encourages, and helps me excel in job interviews. Highly recommend to anyone in tech!

dani.name: Dani
dani.text: Mark is an awesome teacher. He has it all perfectly structured and organized, with a highly professional method tailored exactly to my needs. On top of that, his technical background is directly aligned with my goals. Highly recommended!

carlos.name: Carlos
carlos.text: I've been learning with Mark to boost my technical English and get ready for IT job interviews. Lessons are focused on what I need: learning new words and speaking fluently. His tips made me feel confident talking about tech stuff in English!

estefania.name: Estefanía
estefania.text: Mark prepares classes very thoroughly and has a great method for practicing public speaking, new vocabulary, and mock interviews. He follows up on the agreed lesson plan, but is also flexible enough if you wanna practice something specific.

aleksandr.name: Aleksandr
aleksandr.text: A very structured tutor with plenty of well-chosen materials on topics I care about, especially business, IT, and tech. Lessons stay focused and practical, which makes progress clear and consistent.

sergei.name: Sergei
sergei.text: I highly recommend this coach! He is a true professional with a unique and well-structured teaching method tailored to individual executive needs.

anton.name: Anton
anton.text: Mark is a great professional. I would strongly recommend him if you want to improve your business English, fine-tune your presentations, or improve your speaking skills.
